source_claim: KADOKAWA's Fantasia Bunko catalog identifies Naga's introductory appearance as the Slayers Special story 'Naga no Chosen' and calls Naga Lina's nemesis, directly establishing Naga the Serpent as a character of the Slayers franchise.
notes: The publisher page is for the Slayers Special light novel line and explicitly identifies Naga's first appearance and relationship to Lina.
